760	There I wrote about the topic; above it is modesty, and below
761	I entered the matter of the soul
762	of a person.
763	First, the revealing of the light of the soul: how
764	is its light revealed there?
765	With very sharp points, truly.
766	She can be a high-tech woman earning 200 thousand shekels a month, CEO of such and such companies
767	with international scope, but the main thing is missing: she has no children, she gives birth to none.
768	She gives birth to no
769	children. What is that worth at all?
770	Who needs it?
771	Who asked it of her?
772	We live only once.
773	We live only once.
774	Who will perpetuate her after the end?
775	Who continues her?
776	Who continues her?
777	How important it is not to ruin the mind.
778	The days of youth matter: not to let them pass by, not to miss them.
779	The most beautiful days of life are the days of youth.
780	The most beautiful days.
781	Why waste them?
782	Why get to bad places?
783	Why dig pits that take many years to repair
784	afterward?
785	Why is this needed?
786	My brothers and friends, a wise person does not make mistakes.
787	You know what?
788	You made mistakes, say "I have sinned"; help your sons, who also made mistakes.
789	Sometimes there is a delay of many years in having children because of this.
790	There is a delay, so couples go out for checkups on their own.
791	A couple married two years ago is not checked at all.
792	Do you know this?
793	Every checkup before two years involves a complete transgression, many very serious transgressions.
794	They don't talk about this at all.
795	There is a hormone, I wrote about it in Torat HaNefesh, in the skull, in the brain,
796	that is secreted from stress.
797	It does, oh dear, what damage it does.
798	One of them kills every sign of vitality.
799	There are some who conceived 200 times, and the stress hormone kills.
